title: [Bug 640454] Scope Expense Agent Entra permissions by company
summary: The Expense Agent now manages Microsoft Entra permissions scoped to individual companies, adding company-specific grants on activation and removing them on deactivation while preserving other permissions and disabling the shared application only when no active companies remain.
key_points: Activation always adds exactly one Expense Agent permission for the current company
An existing global grant is kept and the current-company grant is still added
Deactivation removes only the current-company grant and keeps global, other-company and unrelated permissions
The shared Entra application is disabled when no other non-empty company grant remains
SUPER needs no extra permission sets; non-SUPER users need Agent - Admin, Expense Mgmt. Admin, SECURITY and Expense Agent
quote: always add exactly one current-company Expense Agent permission during activation
